evidence: The candidate requires exactly the v3/v4 byte keys, exact bytes types, bounded lengths, and fixed SHA-256 pins.
It compiles isolated V3 and V4 reference modules from those bytes. The V4 reference changes only the unique top-level _V3_MODULE = _load_v3_module() anchor to use the held V3 reference.

It compares module names/paths/spec origin, loader/cache/builtins metadata, global names and values, source-defined function code/globals/defaults/kwdefaults/annotations/closures, and class bases/descriptors/values.
The actual V4 nested V3 module must retain exactly the caller scope object in the V3 retained-scope list; the V4 scope class base must be the actual nested V3 scope class.
The adapter does not consult or register modules in sys.modules; its test checks that the V3 registry entry remains unchanged.
module_source_binding.same_scope_readback: After module comparison, the exact V4 production scope must be OPEN and test_only false; its manifest must pin V3/V4, and read_held must return bytes equal to the supplied source bytes before the pinned R1 helper is loaded or called.
module_source_binding.ancillary_state_limit: The comparator does not separately compare mutable function __dict__/__doc__ attributes or ModuleSpec.loader. I found no corresponding V3/V4 verification path that consumes these fields; executable function code, globals, defaults, closures, class descriptors, and module constants are compared.

preparation_boundary.entry_path: Entry R2 _execute_with_scope via the pinned R1 pre-installer prefix
static_boundary_review: R1 reads Entry R2 bytes through the held scope and extracts the unique _execute_with_scope prefix before its unique helper.install_full_hold_adaptation statement.

The prefix requires the pinned R19 active-map derivation, full-map builder, V4 profiler verifier call, and both R5/R27 source transforms; it rejects installer calls and invoke start/run entry calls before the boundary.
R1 checks 582 public rows, 5 software rows, 3 profiler modules, full union >=582, and held rows >=587 before normal scope release/postverify.

Entry R2 derives active 575 public plus 5 software rows; its pinned cold base is 515, outer map 14 with overlap 11, cold/outer union 518, and active/cold-outer union 582. Support/payload rows are derived into full_union and held with the software rows.
The adapter reports only PREPARATION_VERIFIED_NO_AUTHORITY after the exact R1 success status and scope.state CLOSED; any other result is BLOCKED_RETAINED.
preparation_boundary.call_order: Source check and static AST test confirm module binding precedes exact-scope readback, which precedes pinned R1 helper load and call.
preparation_boundary.failure_retention: Static review confirms scope, V4, supplied source bytes, payload and R1 source are retained on exceptions or non-success results; isolated reference modules/helper are also retained after the binding phase. R1 requests retention on errors or uncertain close.
